page_title: GEN 2-2 INT | Genoa v Inter 17/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The match has just finished.
90+9' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) sees a yellow card from Ermano Feliciani after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
90+8' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Genoa.

90+8' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Vitinha (Genoa). Genoa have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+5' 2 - 2 Goal! 2:2. Junior Messias (Genoa) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.
90+5' Junior Messias (Genoa) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty to the centre of the goal, but it's not enough to beat Yann Sommer who easily stops the effort.
90+5' Junior Messias (Genoa) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+4' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
90+4' Referee Ermano Feliciani makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
90+2' Surely that's handball by one of the Inter players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Inter.
86' Lautaro Martinez comes off the pitch to be replaced by Kristjan Asllani (Inter).
86' Alberto Gilardino has decided to substitute Milan Badelj and he is replaced by Jeff Ekhator (Genoa).
84' Wait! Referee Ermano Feliciani immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
84' 1 - 2 GOAL! Marcus Thuram (Inter) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Pierluigi Gollini, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 1:2.
83' A goal, which was scored by Marcus Thuram (Inter), was disallowed due to offside.
82' 0:3 – the corner kicks stats.
81' Vitinha (Genoa) misses a sitter as his shot goes over the bar.
81' Vitinha (Genoa) tries to find Junior Messias, but he puts too much power on the pass.
79' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) brings his opponent down. Ermano Feliciani has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
75' Simone Inzaghi prepares a substitution. Federico Dimarco is replaced by Carlos Augusto (Inter).
75' Hakan Calhanoglu will be replaced by Mehdi Taremi (Inter).
75' Davide Frattesi (Inter) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
75' Federico Dimarco (Inter) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
75' An attempted cross from Davide Frattesi (Inter) is cleared. Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
71' Substitution. Ruslan Malinovsky leaves the pitch and is replaced by Morten Thorsby (Genoa).
71' Alberto Gilardino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) replacing Alessandro Zanoli.
70' A cooling break is underway.
66' The referee allows time for a substitution. Henrikh Mkhitaryan will be replaced by Davide Frattesi (Inter).
66' Simone Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Matteo Darmian will be replaced by Denzel Dumfries (Inter).
63' Pierluigi Gollini (Genoa) fails to control his temper and is booked by the referee for dissent.
62' Alberto Gilardino (Genoa) gets a yellow card, off the field.
60' That will be all from Alessandro Vogliacco who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Johan Vasquez (Genoa).

59' Nice individual effort by Marcus Thuram (Inter). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a low drive to the middle of the goal, but Pierluigi Gollini does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out.
58' Aaron Martin (Genoa) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
58' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle for a foul.
56' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
56' Handball! A player from Genoa handled the ball. Inter win a free kick.
55' Ermano Feliciani couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Aaron Martin (Genoa) and blew his whistle.
52' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Federico Dimarco (Inter) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
50' Milan Badelj (Genoa) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
48' Matteo Darmian (Inter) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle for a foul.
47' The free kick is delivered by Federico Dimarco (Inter) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle after Lautaro Martinez (Inter) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) commits a foul during an attacking move.
44' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is caught offside!
43' Ermano Feliciani interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Francesco Acerbi (Inter).
43' Federico Dimarco (Inter) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
41' Federico Dimarco (Inter) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
40' Federico Dimarco (Inter) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. Good work from Inter as they win a corner.
40' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Pierluigi Gollini.
38' The penalty decision is reversed after referee Ermano Feliciani changes his mind following the VAR review into the infringement.
38' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the penalty decision using the VAR system.

37' Milan Badelj (Genoa) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. The referee's verdict is crystal clear. A penalty is awarded to Inter!
36' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
35' Inter are seeing far more of the ball now.
33' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:3.

31' Marcus Thuram (Inter) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom right corner. However, Pierluigi Gollini anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.

30' 1 - 1 The ball hits the back of the net! Nicolo Barella showcases his brilliant technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Marcus Thuram (Inter) gets onto the scoresheets by sweetly heading it inside the left post – 1:1.
29' Great teamplay by Genoa as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
26' A spell of possession for Inter in an attempt to control the game.
23' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
20' 1 - 0 Goal 1:0! Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
20' Mattia Bani (Genoa) finds himself some space on the edge of the box to meet a cross from the free kick, but his header only hits the crossbar.
16' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
16' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Ermano Feliciani no option but to blow his whistle.
15' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
15' Matteo Darmian (Inter) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
13' Federico Dimarco (Inter) slams the ball towards the middle of the goal, but it fails to surprise Pierluigi Gollini and he's equal to it.
12' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
11' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) dinks a fine lofted pass from the free kick. However, one of the defenders heads the ball out of danger. The referee signals a corner kick to Inter.
10' Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle. Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) commits a foul after dangerous play. Inter are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
10' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
8' Inter are ruled offside.
8' Marcus Thuram (Inter) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the bottom left corner is thwarted by Pierluigi Gollini.
7' The Inter players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
4' Some great controlled play and passing from Inter. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
3' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Aaron Martin (Genoa).
1' The first half has just begun.
Genoa will kick-off.
Ermano Feliciani will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
